description: Header file defining the FileSelectListener class, which monitors a file for changes and reads data asynchronously using a background thread.

classes.name: FileSelectListener
classes.description: A class that monitors a specified file for new data, reading asynchronously in a separate thread, and invoking a callback function with the data.

methods.name: FileSelectListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the listener with file path, buffer size, and callback, and starts the polling thread.

methods.name: ~FileSelectListener
methods.description: Destructor that signals the thread to stop and joins it.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if the specified file exists and is accessible.

methods.name: pollLoop
methods.description: Main loop running in a separate thread that monitors the file for changes and reads data when available.
